🧝 Character Builder

"Roll for stats. No, the other dice. No, in order. Fine, point buy."

Build a 5e character from the SRD 5.1 one step at a time: race, class, ability scores, background, skills, gear, and spells. The sheet does the math, levels up from 1 to 20, prints clean, and sends the character to your party roster. Need someone fast for a one-shot? Quick Build rolls a whole character in one click.

Everything stays in this browser: up to 30 characters, saved as you go. Export saves one as a file you can import on another device, or hand to your DM. 👥 Add to Party puts the character on the Toolbox's Party tab, where the encounter builder, initiative tracker, and DM Screen can use it.

How the Character Builder works

Work through the steps in any order. Each one shows a red count of what's still to pick and a green check when it's done. The sheet updates as you go, so you can open it at any point and see your Armor Class, hit points, attacks, and spell save DC.

What's in it

  • The nine SRD races: dwarf, elf, halfling, human, dragonborn, gnome, half-elf, half-orc, and tiefling.
  • All twelve classes, each with its SRD subclass, from level 1 to 20, with hit points by average or by rolling. Planning a second class? The Multiclass Calculator checks the prerequisites and works out the combined spell slots.
  • Ability scores by standard array, point buy, 4d6 drop lowest, or your own numbers from the table. Want to compare them first? The Point Buy Calculator tries all four and sends the result here.
  • A notes box for appearance and backstory. Stuck for one? The Backstory Generator rolls traits, an ideal, a bond, a flaw, and a past, and writes them into a character's notes. Once the campaign starts, the sheet's 📓 Journal button keeps the character's session journal: sessions, quests, people, places, and loot.
  • The Acolyte background or one of your own, class starting gear or starting gold, and the Grappler feat. The sheet works out each attack; the Attack Calculator turns them into hit chances and damage per round against any AC.
  • Spells from the Spellbook, filtered by your class and level, each linking to its full page. The Spell Planner swaps a prepared caster's list after a long rest and prints the spells as cut-out cards.

For the DM

Quick Build rolls a complete character of any level, race, and class: an NPC adventuring party, a rival, or pregenerated characters for a one-shot. Add them to the party, then run the fight in the Initiative Tracker or balance it with the Encounter Builder.
